values.note: $24 a night for a standard site (recreation.gov 2026-2028 and the FS page). Extra vehicle $8/night on recreation.gov ($7/day on the FS page).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234083/rates (2026, 2027, 2028 peak and first-come seasons: 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC' 24) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/carp-river-campground ('Single Site: $24 per night'; 'A fee of $7.00 per additional vehicle per day applies in all concessionaire campgrounds') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234083 ('Extra vehicle will be charged an $8 per night fee'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/carp-river-campground ('Campground is rustic. There are no hookups for electricity, water or sewer.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 20 wooded sites, each with a table and fire ring. Max vehicle length 25-45 ft (35 ft on most); 4 pull-throughs. Maximum 8 people per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/carp-river-campground ('Carp River Campground has 20 wooded campsites'; 'Maximum 8 people per site') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234083 (20 standard non-electric sites; Max Vehicle Length 25 (2), 30 (2), 35 (14), 45 (2); 16 back-in, 4 pull-through), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Water pumps and vault toilets spaced through the campground. Stairs down the riverbank to the Carp River. Self-pay station; no office on site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/carp-river-campground ('Water pumps and vault toilets are conveniently spaced throughout the campground'; 'Access the Carp River using one of the stair sets constructed along the riverbank') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234083 ('We do not have an office at this location. It has a self pay station.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or (877) 444-6777 up to 4 days before arrival; 8 of the 20 sites are first-come, and the rate table runs a first-come week before the peak season (2026: May 15-21). Weekend reservations 2 nights, holiday weekends 3 (recreation.gov rules; they may be relaxed for a same-day booking). A reservation is forfeited if you have not arrived by checkout time the day after arrival; you must occupy the site the first night.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/carp-river-campground ('Campground has first come, first served sites and reservable sites. Reservations can be made using www.recreation.gov or by calling (877) 444-6777'; 'Reservations are forfeited if you have not arrived by check-out time the day after your scheduled arrival') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234083 (rules: reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14) + catalog (8 sites reservable: false), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Golden Age and America the Beautiful Senior/Access passes give half-price camping. Military Annual and Gold Star passes cover day-use fees only, not camping.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/carp-river-campground ('Discount passes are honored with ½ price camping only include: Golden Age Passport and America the Beautiful (Interagency) Senior Pass issued to senior citizens and physically disabled citizens'; 'Military Annual and Gold Star Veteran Passes are good for covering day use fees ONLY, they do not cover camping fees.'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Hiawatha NF campground of wooded sites beside the Carp Wild and Scenic River, about 8 mi from St. Ignace via Mackinac Trail (H-63) and a quarter mile on FR 3445; brook, brown and rainbow trout from stair sets down the riverbank, plus canoeing and kayaking. Concession-run. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov + catalog: $24 (2026-2028, confirmed), 20 sites (confirmed) to 45 ft with 4 pull-throughs, no hookups (confirmed), vault toilets + water pumps (confirmed), reservable on recreation.gov with 8 first-come sites (confirmed), 4-day cutoff, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max, season May 15 - Sep 13 (added), senior/access half price (confirmed), no military camping discount. No current alert for the campground or FR 3445. Note trimmed of field restatements.
